certification_name: Red Hat Certified System Administrator in OpenShift

objectives.title: Use the web console to manage and configure an OpenShift cluster
Use the command-line interface to manage and configure an OpenShift cluster
Identify images using tags and digests
Query, format, and filter attributes of Kubernetes resources
Import, export, and configure Kubernetes resources
Assess the health of an OpenShift cluster
Troubleshoot common container, pod, and cluster events and alerts
Be prepared to perform all tasks of a Red Hat Certified Technologist in OpenShift
Deploy applications from YAML resource manifests
Deploy applications from templates and Helm charts
Configure the HTPasswd identity provider for authentication
Secure external and internal traffic using TLS certificates
Manage and apply permissions using security context constraints
Create and apply secrets to manage sensitive information
Configure application access to Kubernetes APIs
Deploy jobs to perform one-time tasks

exam_name: Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration – EX280
exam_rules: Performance-based: tasks completed in a live RHEL environment. Access to man pages and documentation is allowed during the exam. No internet access to external sites. No notes or books. All work done in the exam's provided terminal/environment.
id_requirements: Government-issued photo ID required. Name must match Red Hat Learning Subscription / Red Hat customer account exactly.

lifecycle.summary: Confirmed current on the issuer host on 2026-09-17: "The Red Hat Certified System Administrator in OpenShift exam (EX280) tests the knowledge, skills, and ability to create, configure, and manage a cloud application platform using Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform."

official_study_resources.notes: Official Red Hat training courses aligned to certification exams
official_study_resources.title: Red Hat Learning Subscription

question_types: Performance-Based (hands-on tasks in live RHEL environment)
recommended_experience: Experience with container technology is recommended. Candidates should have taken Red Hat System Administration I (RH124) or have comparable experience. Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) is strongly recommended but not required. Candidates should have taken Red Hat OpenShift Administration I (DO180) and Red Hat OpenShift Administration II (DO280) courses or have comparable work experience using OpenShift Container Platform.
renewal_options: Red Hat certifications are valid for 3 years. Renew by passing any Red Hat exam tied to the current major version of RHEL, or by passing the same exam again.

retake_policy.notes: No mandatory waiting period between attempts. Full exam fee required for retake.

target_audience: System and Software Architects, System Administrators, Cluster Operators, Site Reliability Engineers, Developers

testing_centers.notes: Remote kiosk-based exams via Red Hat's own platform. Also available at Red Hat partner test centers.

version: based on Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4.18
